name: @waste/contracts
description: Shared wire primitives on zod 4: ids (UUIDv7), ISO dates, GeoJSON Position, Point and Polygon, cursor pagination, the health response, the permission vocabulary (from @waste/domain). Consumed by apps/web and apps/api, and by packages/db for its types only. No module schemas yet; each context's are derived from its form schemas when its tables are designed (build-order step 3 on). Ships TypeScript source for bundler and tsx consumers.
